# POWALIFTA

> POWALIFTA is a powerlifting app for coaches and their lifters. Lifters log every set with RPE on their phone; the app works out each lifter's estimated one-rep max (e1RM) from every set. Coaches see each set land on a laptop dashboard that ranks who needs them today (pain on a check-in, a meet coming up, weight to cut, a lift that felt harder than written), write programs in RPE or percentages, and send next week in a few clicks. Free for lifters; coaches coach three lifters free, then pay for more seats.

Built for the barbell. iPhone app on the App Store; Android in the browser (its own app in late December). Apple Health from December: sleep, resting heart rate and weigh-ins into each lifter's readiness, shared with their coach when the lifter chooses.

- [Your data](https://www.powalifta.com/data.html): who owns training data, export and deletion

## Guides
- [RPE for powerlifting](https://www.powalifta.com/guide-rpe.html): RIR, autoregulation and how to use RPE
- [Estimated 1RM (e1RM)](https://www.powalifta.com/guide-e1rm.html): the formula and why it beats maxing out
- [DOTS score](https://www.powalifta.com/guide-dots.html): comparing totals across bodyweights
- [Peaking for a meet](https://www.powalifta.com/guide-peaking.html): a taper walkthrough
- [Exercise library](https://www.powalifta.com/exercises.html): cues and faults for the lifts and their variants

## Facts
- e1RM: weight / (1 - ((reps - 1) + (10 - RPE)) * 0.0333)
- Plans: Free (up to 3 lifters), Basic (4 to 10), Pro (11 to 25), Premium (26 or more)
- Contact: powalifta1320@gmail.com
